title: Nothing to Report
description: A dispatcher runs the summary report over a date window with no shipments in it, like a slow holiday week. The chart should render zero everything, not error out.
successCondition: GET /api/reporting/summary as a dispatcher, with a from/to window set far in the past where no shipments exist (e.g. year 2000), returns 200 with buckets equal to an empty array [], totalShipments 0, and totalRevenueCents 0.
hints: This is a clean, valid 200 response with empty/zero fields — not a 404 or validation error.
Pick a date range you're confident predates any seeded or test-created shipment data in your environment.
